title: Yoga for Young Adults Affected by Cancer
official: Yoga for Young Adults Affected by Cancer: Exploring Implementation and Effectiveness of an Online Program
summary: Yoga may enhance physical and psychological outcomes among young adults affected by cancer. Yet, yoga has rarely been studied in this population. We developed and piloted a yoga program, which is now ready for implementation and evaluation. This single-group, mixed-methods project will explore effectiveness and implementation of the yoga program.
